Name: Collapsing On The Farm Fix (Beta)
Author: monsoonsheep
Description:
If you ever pass out from exhaustion on your farm, it wouldn't make sense that someone from Joja or the town finds you and puts you to bed. I made this mod to address that. If you're married or have a roommate, your partner will have taken you to your bed, and when you wake up they'll be beside you, probably worried for you.

[size=4]Contributions
[/size]This mod supports adding more dialogue and event scripts with Content Patcher. If you're interested to add or translate, edit the i18n files and let me know so I can add the changes.

This mod goes well with CasualInvidia's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7493]Spouses React to Player 'Death'[/url] mod, which adds events and dialogue for when you "die" and go to the hospital, though that doesn't take into account whether you died on the farm or not, so I've added an event for that, which can be edited with Content Patcher or just turned off.

[size=4]Beta[/size]
I'm still working on making this mod work in different environments like multiplayer, split-screen, and with several other mods installed.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Needs testing for multiplayer
[/list]
